findings.quote: The reactions were analyzed and quantified by LC-MS and integrated against the trimethoxybenzene internal standard to determine the yield of product formed in each reaction and the amount of unreacted starting material remaining. Yields determined by LC-MS were also validated by quantification of the 1H NMR spectrum of the indicated entries.
